summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to be held October 6, 2026, in Xiamen, China, with a record date of September 15, 2026. Shareholders will vote on special resolutions to amend the articles to grant each Class B ordinary share 200 votes and adopt new articles, plus an ordinary resolution authorizing up to two 1-for-50 share consolidations if the Class A market price falls below US$1.00. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. The filing is a routine EGM notice, not a special situation.
